SD28-013.name: Counter Bind
SD28-013.effect:
[Trigger Counter]
When an opposing Ultimate Trigger hits, if this Magic card is in your Hand, you can use the following effect before the "When hits" effect activates.

█ If the Hit card is Green, treat it as a Guard.

[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD28-014.name: Exhaust End
SD28-014.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
For each card the opponent increases when this Burst was activated, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
For every two cards in the opposing Hand, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD28-001.name: Gigantea-Kamikiri
SD28-001.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

SD28-007.name: Koganehime
SD28-007.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4]
Ignore the summon conditions of all your Green Ultimate cards. The Ultimate symbols of all your "Shellman" family Ultimates are also treated as Green symbols.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate-Trigger hits, exhaust two opposing Spirits.
[utb]

SD28-011.name: The AstralBeastBlade Procyon
SD28-011.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any Ultimate you control.

[When Braved] (When this Spirit Brave Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[When Braved] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD28-X02.name: The EarthDeitySword Gaianohoko
SD28-X02.effect:
When your Ultimate is summoned, you can summon this card from the Hand without paying the cost.

[During Brave]
While braved to an Ultimate without Cross Ultimate Trigger, this Brave's Cost becomes 0.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
The opposing Burst can't activate.

SD28-012.name: The Jade Sword Detector
SD28-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, draw a card.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Green "Exalted Sword" family Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

SD28-009.name: The Last Emperor
SD28-009.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 3 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to this Ultimate.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, exhaust two opposing Spirits. After Ultimate Trigger, if your Life is at three or less, proceed to Cross Ultimate Trigger.
[Cross Ultimate Trigger] When Cross Ultimate Trigger hits, send an opposing Life to their Trash.
[xutb]

SD28-008.name: The ToughSwordMaster Rubeet
SD28-008.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (When Battles)
Exhaust an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.

[When Braved] [Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the decktop.
[utb]

SD28-010.name: The WingedBlade Gruid
SD28-010.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Brave card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
This Ultimate gains +5000 BP.

SD28-015.name: Ultimate Gain
SD28-015.effect:
[Flash]
Refresh all your Brave Ultimates. During this turn, the Ultimate Triggers of any Ultimates refreshed by this effect can't activate.

SD28-X01.name: Ultimate-Ushiwaka
SD28-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits/Ultimates]

[Burst: After your Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by the Opponent]
Exhaust two opposing Spirits, or an opposing Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this Ultimate card.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Battles)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, at the end of battle, by returning this Ultimate to your Hand, refresh an Ultimate you control.
[utb]
